description: Open one or more transcribed document pages in an interactive deep-zoom viewer with the transcription text alongside. Pass page identifiers returned by search_transcriptions / browse_transcriptions (form <ISIL>_<archive>_<page>, e.g. NL-SdmGA_1504889_11). Optionally highlight a term in the transcript. Hosts without MCP Apps support receive a text summary plus inline preview images.

highlight_term.description: Optional term to highlight in the transcription text.

name: view_transcription
title: View Transcription (IIIF deep-zoom)
